pages.title: The green one is right
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! Thank you for looking for my gift. I like the green T-shirt. Medium is right for me. I don’t need a jacket. Twelve dollars is OK. Can you bring the T-shirt on Friday? We can meet at the café. Thank you!
